questions.q: Which of the following best describes **government** when defined as an institution of the state?
options: A geographical territory with defined and universally recognized physical boundaries.
The established machinery or agency through which the will of the state is formulated, expressed, and realized.
A registered mass political party that exclusively conducts nationwide general elections.
An international cooperative organization that provides financial loans to developing countries.
questions.explain: As an institution, **government** is defined as the machinery, agency, or body of persons established by a state to formulate public policies, execute laws, and manage the administrative affairs of the people.
questions.exam: NECO Civic Education Part 2: Social Vices, National Development & Governance
questions.subject: Civic Education

questions.q: In a federal state like Nigeria, the structure of government is constitutionally divided into three distinct **tiers** or levels, which are the...
options: civil service, armed forces, and the police.
questions.explain:
The **tiers of government** refer to the vertical division of governmental authority across different geographical levels. In Nigeria, power is shared among the **Federal, State, and Local governments**. 

*(Note: The Executive, Legislature, and Judiciary represent the horizontal arms or branches of government, not the tiers).*

questions.q: Which of the following represents the most fundamental security function of a sovereign government?
options: Compelling all citizens to join the national armed forces upon graduation
Ensuring the complete elimination of all opposition political parties
Protecting lives, property, and defending the state against external aggression
Providing an unrestricted right for citizens to carry firearms
questions.explain: A primary and non-negotiable function of any legitimate government is the **protection of lives and property**, maintenance of internal law and order, and the defense of the state's territorial integrity against **external aggression**.
questions.exam: NECO Civic Education Part 2: Social Vices, National Development & Governance
questions.subject: Civic Education

questions.q: When the government allocates its annual budget to construct public schools, equip hospitals, and build road networks, it is primarily fulfilling its...
questions.explain: The functions of government are broadly categorized. Providing basic amenities (like healthcare, public education, electricity, and transportation infrastructure) falls directly under its **socio-economic and welfare functions**, which are aimed at improving the standard of living of the citizens.
